title: Frankfurter Dumpling Soup
description: A hearty and comforting soup made with Malaysian-inspired dumplings and served with a side of sausages. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the chopped cabbage and sliced carrots and cook until tender.
In a separate pan, cook the frankfurter sausages until browned.
Add the cooked sausages to the pot with the cabbage and carrots.
Mix in the soy sauce and stir to combine.
Wrap the dumpling dough around small balls of filling (about 20g each) to form dumplings.
Add the dumplings to the pot and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the chopped scallions and grated ginger.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
